meta.name: debug
meta.description: Investigate and repair a reproducible failure in a customer integration or application. Use for diagnosis and regression prevention; follow incident authority for live mitigation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把可复现的故障查清根因并修好,顺带防止它再次发生
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果客户集成或应用出现可复现的报错,需要定位根因并留下防止复发的措施。
copy.tagline_en: Trace a reproducible failure to its root cause, fix it, and stop it from coming back
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a customer integration or app fails reproducibly and you need root cause plus a fix.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调查并修复客户集成或应用程序里可复现的故障,产出诊断结论和回归预防;缺能力或未运行的检查会如实说明。它按自带的流程参考文档工作,不需要其他技能包。
howto.when: 当你遇到可复现的故障、需要诊断并防止复发时进入。若由 @fde 调用,它复用对方已脱敏的上下文与范围,不再重启设置或重复提问。

say.text: 这个客户集成里的报错能稳定复现,帮我定位根因。
say.note: 它会按方法文档逐步排查。

say.text: 修完之后补上回归预防,别让同样故障再出现。
say.note: 结论里会带上防复发措施。

say.text: 不要重启流程,在 @fde 已确认的范围内继续排查。
say.note: 它会复用已有上下文与范围。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude investigates and repairs a reproducible failure in a customer integration or app, producing a diagnosis and regression prevention. Missing capabilities or unrun checks are reported honestly.
howto.when_en: Use when a reproducible failure needs diagnosis and regression prevention. When called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.text: This failure reproduces every time—help me find the root cause.
say_en.note: It steps through the method reference.

say_en.text: After the fix, add regression prevention so it can't recur.
say_en.note: Prevention is included in the write-up.

say_en.text: Don't restart setup—continue within @fde's confirmed scope.
